user_policy: Sliver framework implementation, including its operator transport, is hostile.
methods: Analyzed all 100 original or relocated files with atomscan --format=json before and after the improvements, including extracted children.
Reviewed matching descriptions and the prior static endpoint analysis; checked imports, arguments, call provenance, and known helper contracts.
Parsed and scanned controls at neutral paths; no sample code was executed.

improvements.subject: Sliver operator WireGuard/gRPC transport
changes: Replaced local helper-name fingerprints with a Sliver RPC-client return type bound to the actual module import.
Custom-context dialer recognition accepts Go import aliases; the hostile channel additionally requires the gRPC module import.
Removed a local RPC helper spelling that neither identified gRPC nor generalized to renamed source.
controls: Original and renamed Sliver remain hostile in two independent directories.
Ordinary WireGuard with different module imports and commented Sliver source do not identify Sliver.
improvements.limit: This detects operator transport source; it does not claim an implant task dispatcher.

improvements.subject: OffensiveGolang startup gates
changes: Added executable-basename, mouse-movement and display-size gating observations using inspected upstream API contracts.
Bound startup calls to the real evasion module, including explicit import aliases.
controls: Original and alias versions match all three gates.
Commented calls and a shadowing local checker do not match.
improvements.limit: The mouse/display matchers deliberately admit only the initial call-only portion of main; a later or indirect call is outside this coverage. The placeholder injection example remains purgatory.

improvements.subject: Keyed hub bootstrap
changes: Added endpoint-to-client-start provenance, hub public-key assignment and TLS-client helper observations.
Combined them with the existing browser User-Agent observation as suspicious keyed-hub transport context.
controls: Changed hostname, port, constructor variant, client variable, and package alias remain covered.
Missing hub key, missing browser User-Agent, unrelated Start receiver, and commented source do not produce the composite.
improvements.placement: The fixed endpoint belongs in socket/endpoint: its value reaches a generic client Start helper, without establishing a known socket-connect API. No split or exception was added to the full socket/connect directory.
limits: Missing local/base and lib/fakehttp dependencies prevent a claim about command handling, AutoClean semantics, or TLS verification behavior.
The composite requires same-file co-occurrence; it does not assert that all roles are flow-linked to the same object.

improvements.subject: ELF header construction
changes: Added same-buffer ELF marker writes at offsets 1, 2 and 3.
Added copying of a complete ELF signature into a buffer.
controls: Buffer renaming and intervening comments remain covered.
Writes split between different buffers and commented code do not match.
improvements.limit: A header-building observation is notable; it does not establish a written, loaded or executed payload.

improvements.subject: Public Tor nonce prefix
changes: Replaced Go raw-text hashing recognition with a parsed literal-only argument, rejecting comments and an appended secret.
Added the precomputed public prefix passed to the real encoding/hex decoder, including import aliases.
controls: Literal-only hash and precomputed decoder variants match.
Commented examples, secret-appended hashing, and a different decoder module do not match the corresponding observation.
improvements.limit: The existing direct-hash matcher uses the Sum512 selector and literal argument, rather than proving the imported hash implementation.

improvements.subject: Description readability
changes: Reworded remote allocation/thread wrappers, virtual-address reading, LSA decryption, custom context dialing, and the Sliver channel to describe the observed behavior in plain language.

atomscan.note: The batch returns 1 when findings are present; all 100 JSON reports were produced and no per-file error was returned.

isolated_make_validate.scope: Previously validated frozen Go-review snapshot plus exactly the 23 x-improve files listed below; unrelated concurrent edits excluded.

shared_make_validate.status: blocked by unrelated concurrent rule errors

simple alternation chain in one trait

limits: Static source inspection and scanner validation only; no endpoint detonation or sample execution.
The scanner reports older ML feature spec v18 against expected v21. No ML score was used as proof of malicious behavior and no model was modified.
Source-local analysis gaps are preserved per sample. Historical disposition rationales and dependency limits remain in the linked prior reviews.
